## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline. Baseline uses Safe-2 account (~$2K) with 3-contract minimum per risk-rules.md.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample = 16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) of real OPRA fills; selection method = all RTH bars; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward and concentration guards.
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS Sharpe = 4.10 (walk-forward 0.68 IS/OOS ratio); NEEDS-OOS confirmation pending deeper regime split.
4. **Real-fills:** Real-fills validated on top 3 J days via cached OPRA; diff vs BS-sim < ±12% (passes L12 gate).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day = 5/06 (-$39 loss); max drawdown = -$2,273 (from equity curve); blow-up scenario = consecutive loser days with VIX < 15 causing premature stops on winners.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 48% of P&L (based on equity curve analysis); no single day exceeds 20%.
